name: Alchemical Flame Jet (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature can spew a jet of alchemical fire in a line 20 feet long and 5 feet wide. Any creature in the path of the jet takes 26 (4d12) fire damage, or half damage with a successful DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. The creature can use this attack four times before its internal reservoir is emptied.
